# Build: window-resize-fix (Current profile) - URGENT bug fix

## Brett said (verbatim, Nov 3 2026, voice)
"Why can't I resize terminal? All floating windows need to be resizable. And also, I selected dialog for the terminal settings in its settings, but it doesn't open."

Assigned agent: whoever is free (router if on main; else **Landin' Lenny**; record who). Register in the `current` profile (id `window-resize-fix`) + banner entry. Fix right away, tell after.

## Bug 1: floating windows can't be resized (phone at least)
- The window engine got resize from all 8 edges/corners in windows-terminal s6 (refactor-all s17-s23, report `_claude/memory/docs/rebuilds/windows-terminal-fable.md`). Brett can't resize the Terminal floating window now. Find why on the live console (console.amberxai.com, his phone + desktop): handles missing/too small for touch, pointer events not wired for touch (need pointer events + touch-action none on handles), a later change (one-look, xlayout/dock engine #245/#252, compact frame, Molly chrome) overriding the window host, or the Terminal opening in a non-window host.
- Fix in the framework window host so EVERY floating window in every app is resizable: 8 edges + corners, big enough touch targets on phones (invisible hit area ~16-24 px, visible grip in the corner), min/max size from tokens, remembers size per window, double-tap title = maximize/restore. CI test: every floating window exposes resize handles.

## Bug 2: Terminal settings placement 'dialog' does nothing
- Terminal's own setting for where its settings open: Brett picked 'dialog' and tapping the gear no longer opens anything (before, it opened the main settings page). Fix so 'dialog' opens the Terminal settings in a pop-up dialog and the main-page option still works. Check every plugin that has this option for the same bug. Coordinate with the queued `plugin-settings-placement` build only via its contract; this is the quick fix for the existing option.

## Done
Tests (resize via pointer + touch, dialog placement), phone + desktop before/after screenshots, UI Review item, report `_claude/builds/reports/window-resize-fix.md`, THREADS, PR, steps through the store. Commits clean and professional.
## Addendum 1 (Brett, Nov 3 2026, voice): "Run that right here, right now, and merge it, deploy it."
Brett's explicit order for THIS build only: when tests pass, merge the PR into main yourself right away (do NOT wait for UI Review; still submit the UI Review item for the record, marked 'merged on Brett's order'), then make sure the console (axf-console), axHub web, AmberX web and Molly redeploy with it (CI deploy on main / Coolify redeploy), and confirm the live console has the fix. Keep it small and fast: fix the two bugs, no extras.

# Build: terminal-sessions-nav (Current profile)

Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice): give the Terminal a collapsible navigation menu on the left listing live sessions, including each session he is personally doing with Claude, so he can mirror it and jump in. Assigned agent: whoever is free (router if on main; else **Earl the Ear**; record who). Register in `current` (id `terminal-sessions-nav`) + banner entry. Runs after / builds on `terminal-vps-host` (the Terminal's VPS host must be set up; if that isn't on main yet, wait for it or include its fix).

## Build INTO the existing Terminal plugin (Windows Terminal + headless-tabs). No second terminal.
- s1 **Left nav rail:** collapsible (icon-only collapsed, full when open, swipe/hamburger on phone), framework nav component + tokens, remembers state. Sections: **My sessions** (Brett's own), **Agents** (headless builds, with agent avatar/name, model, live cost, status dot - reuse headless meters), **Connections** (VPS, containers, axHub...). Tap = open/focus that tab; right-click = context menu (open, split, open in Moshi, stop with confirm, session info).
- s2 **My sessions:** (a) Claude Code sessions he runs (tmux / claude-headless / phone via Moshi, Session check-in archive) - live mirror of the tmux pane, read-only by default, **Jump in** = attach writable and type into it. (b) Claude.ai chat/voice sessions (Amber): claude.ai has no live API for the transcript, so mirror what reaches axHub: every axHub call the session makes (tool, args summary, result, approvals) as a live activity feed per session (group by axHub session/correlation + client), with the session's agent (agent-pick) and cost if known; 'Jump in' = open that chat in claude.ai (deep link if the session reports its URL) and keep the feed beside it. Add MCP tool `console_session_note` (allow) so a Claude session can post what it's saying/doing as short lines into its own mirror feed, and add a rule: 'Chat/voice sessions post a short line to console_session_note when they act.' Zero tokens on the console side.
- s3 Session list is live (websocket), shows started time + running timer, sort/search/filter, collapsible groups; ended sessions move to a 'Recent' group (link to Session browser).
- s4 Commands declared once -> REST + MCP + CLI (list sessions, mirror, jump in, stop). Tests, phone + desktop screenshots, UI Review item, report `_claude/builds/reports/terminal-sessions-nav.md`, THREADS, PR, steps through the store. Commits clean and professional.

# Build: profile-manager (Current profile)

Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice): a plugin to manage build profiles: view, browse, create, edit, delete, everything. Assigned agent: **Landin' Lenny** (book on his card; if busy and the all-rounder router is on main, whoever is free - record who). Register in the **current** profile (id `profile-manager`) + banner entry. (Profile `current` was just created; if it's missing, create it: `node framework/cli/profiles.mjs create "Current" --id current --select`.)

## Build on what exists - don't duplicate
The console already has the **Build profiles** plugin (`build-profiles`: dialog + settings tab, banner chip, switch/create/rename/remove) over `framework/cli/profiles.mjs` (build-profiles@1) and the builds store. Grow THAT plugin into a full manager page (rename the plugin title to 'Build profiles' manager if needed; keep its id, data and every existing feature).

## Features
- **Browse:** framework grid of every profile (collapsible rows): name, id, active star, description, counts (builds running / pending / complete / archived, pending items, queue steps), cost spent + cost left, last activity, created; sort/search/filter. Expand a row: its builds (with agent avatars once crew-live lands), pending list, queue, plan summary, files (`profiles.mjs where`).
- **View** a profile page: all its builds and steps, timeline, totals, links to Builds page views filtered to it.
- **Create** (name, id, description, copy from another profile, catalog on/off, make active), **Edit** (name, description, catalog, colour/icon for the banner chip), **Switch** (one tap; banner chip + context menu), **Duplicate**, **Merge** two profiles, **Move builds** between profiles (multi-select, drag rows onto a profile), **Archive / hide**, **Delete** = take off the list (data kept, restorable) with confirm; a separate 'Delete data too' that is owner-only and irreversible-confirm. Base profile and active profile can't be deleted.
- **Cleanup helper:** flag archived builds that are actually complete (reconciler) - e.g. angel, big-dog, breakroom, refactor - with a one-tap fix.
- Context-menu hooks everywhere: 'Build profiles...' and 'Move to profile' on any build row.
- Commands declared once -> REST + MCP + CLI (list, get, create, update, select, duplicate, merge, move-builds, archive, remove, restore) so Amber can manage profiles by voice (reads ALLOW policy, changes veto, data delete confirm).
- Tests, phone + desktop screenshots, UI Review item, report `_claude/builds/reports/profile-manager.md`, THREADS, PR, steps through the store. Commits clean and professional.
